t: This is Thomas More Street, a short, winding road in Tower Hamlets, running between St Katharine Docks to the west and Wapping to the east. It was formerly called Nightingale Lane. The name now honours Sir Thomas More, the lawyer, statesman and Renaissance humanist, who served Henry VIII as Lord Chancellor from 1529 to 1532. He wrote Utopia, published in 1516, and the Catholic Church venerates him as a martyr and saint.
